short_explanation: Treatment: randomized treatment assignment with cleaned-data arms: Active tDCS; Sham tDCS. Publication-designated control/reference: Sham tDCS.
Baseline covariate: Attention Repeatable Battery for the Assessment of Neuropsychological Status.

Primary outcome: Attention Repeatable Battery for the Assessment of Neuropsychological Status, measured immediately after the intervention. Publication-defined endpoint context: RBANS Attention Index after 3 weeks.

Primary outcome: Change from baseline to immediately after the intervention in attention Repeatable Battery for the Assessment of Neuropsychological Status. Publication-defined endpoint context: RBANS Attention Index after 3 weeks.
Secondary outcome: Burnout mbs, measured immediately after the intervention.
Secondary outcome: Change from baseline to immediately after the intervention in burnout mbs.
Secondary outcome: Depression bdi, measured immediately after the intervention.
Secondary outcome: Quality of life, measured immediately after the intervention.
